A ship sails due North at a speed of 20m/s. A current in the water begins to move from East to
West. The speed of this current is 20m/s.
What is the magnitude of the resultant velocity of the ship?
A
0m/s
B
20m/s
C
28m/s
D
40m/s
subject: Physics
